criteria.name: progression
criteria.description: Does the chapter sequence move the reader forward rather than circling the same idea?

criteria.name: chapter_distinctiveness
criteria.description: Is every chapter's new_idea genuinely distinct from every other chapter?

criteria.name: practical_payoff_density
criteria.description: Do enough chapters (>70%) have a clear, specific practical takeaway?

criteria.name: dependency_logic
criteria.description: Are chapter dependencies sensible — does the sequence build knowledge correctly?

criteria.name: scope_fit
criteria.description: Does the outline deliver on the book brief's core promise without scope creep?
